comments.author: Wright
comments.body:
This r16 cooking recipe can be found in E. Mediterranean Cuisine Collection. It needs 1 Lamb / 1 Pita / 1 Frites.

Pita is a r3 cooking recipe and can be made with 1 salt / 1 olive oil and the recipe is in Bread Basics

Frites is a r6 cooking recipe and can be made with 1 potatoes / 1 salt / 1 vegetable oil and the recipe can be found in Simple Recipes
